misconceptions.name: 用 for 加动词表示“为了”
misconceptions.why: 汉语“为了”常译成 for，就把 for 直接放在动词前面。
misconceptions.move: 两栏对比：for + 名词（for fun、for a walk），to + 动词（to relax、to keep fit），让学生把例子分进对的一栏。

misconceptions.name: 表示目的的动作前漏了 to
misconceptions.why: 汉语“游泳保持健康”两个动作直接连着说，“为了”常省掉。
misconceptions.move: 问：游泳是为了什么？在“为了”的那个动作前补上 to，全班读 swims every morning to keep fit。

misconceptions.name: make、let 后面也加了 to
misconceptions.why: 刚学了 ask/tell sb to do，就以为宾语后面的动词都要加 to。
misconceptions.move: 列两栏：ask、tell、want、encourage sb to do；make、let、have sb do，让学生把 made 放进对的一栏。

misconceptions.name: 反身代词都用物主代词加 self
misconceptions.why: myself、yourself、ourselves 都是物主代词加 -self，就以为 him、them 也这样变。
misconceptions.move: 板书两组：my/your + self、our/your + selves；him/her/it + self、them + selves，让学生圈出第三人称前半截用宾格 him/them，不是 his/their。

misconceptions.name: 复数主语后用了 -self
misconceptions.why: 只记住了 -self，没注意几个人要变成 -selves。
misconceptions.move: 问：they 是几个人？一个人 -self，几个人 -selves，像 shelf → shelves。

misconceptions.name: 宾语指主语自己还用宾格
misconceptions.why: taught 后面要跟宾语，就顺手写了宾格 them，没想到教的就是他们自己。
misconceptions.move: 问：教的是谁？是双胞胎自己——宾语和主语是同一批人，就用 themselves；them 会被听成别人。

misconceptions.name: although 和 but 连用
misconceptions.why: 汉语习惯说“虽然……但是……”，两个连词成对出现。
misconceptions.move: 擦掉 but 读一遍，再擦掉 although 读一遍：各自都对，两个一起就错。

misconceptions.name: 把“直到……才”说成肯定句
misconceptions.why: 汉语“雨停了才走”是肯定的说法，就照着用了 will leave，没想到雨停前是“不走”。
misconceptions.move: 问：雨停之前我们走不走？不走——所以说 won't leave … until the rain stops。

misconceptions.name: 时间从句也用了 will
misconceptions.why: 说的是将来的事，就在 until、when、as soon as 后面也用 will。
misconceptions.move: 讲“主将从现”：划出 until 后面的从句，把 will stop 改成 stops，再读整句。

misconceptions.name: 比较动作时用了形容词
misconceptions.why: 汉语“更小心”修饰人和修饰动作是同一个词，不分形容词和副词。
misconceptions.move: 问：比的是爸爸这个人，还是他“走”的样子？比动作用副词：carefully → more carefully。

misconceptions.name: 正在进行的背景动作用了一般过去时
misconceptions.why: 汉语说“地震时叔叔阿姨在院子里干活”，动词不变，只想到是过去就用了 worked。
misconceptions.move: 画时间轴：一长条是“干活”，一个点是“地震”；点落在长条上，长条用 was/were doing。

misconceptions.name: 过去正在做的事用了现在进行时
misconceptions.why: 记住了“正在”就是 be doing，忘了 be 也要跟着变成过去式。
misconceptions.move: 圈出 last year，问：这是现在还是过去？过去正在做的事，be 也要变：are → were。

misconceptions.name: 复数主语用了 was
misconceptions.why: 以为 was 就是 be 的过去式，没按主语分 was 和 were。
misconceptions.move: 对照板书：am/is → was，are → were；问：my aunt and uncle 现在用 is 还是 are？

misconceptions.name: while 后接了一下子的动作
misconceptions.why: 以为 when 和 while 都是“当……时”，可以随便换。
misconceptions.move: 问：闪电击中树要多久？一瞬间就用 when；while 后面接一段时间里正在进行的事：While we were having PE, …

misconceptions.name: 说事物用了 -ed 形容词
misconceptions.why: 只记住 surprised 是“惊讶的”，没分清“让人惊讶”和“感到惊讶”。
misconceptions.move: 问：是这件事自己“感到”惊讶，还是它“让人”惊讶？让人……的用 -ing：It was surprising.

misconceptions.name: 说人的感受用了 -ing 形容词
misconceptions.why: 汉语“尴尬”既能说人也能说事，就以为两种形式随便用。
misconceptions.move: 做手势：-ed 指向自己（我感到……），-ing 指向外面（它让人……）；读 He felt embarrassed. / It was embarrassing.

misconceptions.name: 把 -ing、-ed 的分工记反
misconceptions.why: 知道两种形式有分工，却把“人用 -ed、事用 -ing”记反了。
misconceptions.move: 给一句记忆句：I'm bored because the film is boring. 全班读两遍，再圈出哪个说人、哪个说事。

misconceptions.name: unless 后面又加了 not
misconceptions.why: 把 unless 记成“除非”，又照着“如果不”加了 not，成了双重否定。
misconceptions.move: 板书 unless = if … not，问：unless 里已经有“不”了，还要再加 not 吗？换成 if you don't hurry 对照读。

misconceptions.name: 把 yet 当成“已经”
misconceptions.why: 词表里 yet 也注了“已经”，就以为它和 already 能随便换。
misconceptions.move: 先看句子是肯定还是否定、疑问：肯定句用 already，否定句和疑问句用 yet，全班各读一句。

misconceptions.name: 否定句里也用 already
misconceptions.why: already 和现在完成时一起学的，就以为完成时里都放 already，没注意否定句要换成 yet。
misconceptions.move: 问：给老师看了没有？没有——还没发生的事说 haven't … yet，already 只说已经发生的事。

misconceptions.name: 瞬间动词配了一段时间
misconceptions.why: 汉语“加入两年了”“来了三年了”里的动词都能接时间，就说成 has become、has come。
misconceptions.move: 问：“成为”会员要多久？一瞬间。要说持续两年，换成能持续的 be：has been a member。

misconceptions.name: 持续到现在的事用了一般现在时
misconceptions.why: 汉语“是会员两年了”动词不变，觉得现在还在当，就用了 is。
misconceptions.move: 画时间轴：从两年前连到现在，问：只说现在，还是连着过去？连着过去用 has/have done。

misconceptions.name: 没有 think 就当成事实
misconceptions.why: 只记住了“找 think、believe 等关键词”，以为没有这些词、说得很肯定的句子就是事实。
misconceptions.move: 问：这句话能查证吗？换个人会不会有不同说法？“最放松”因人而异，就是观点，哪怕没有 think。

misconceptions.name: 只认词根，没看后缀 -less
misconceptions.why: 认出了 pain 是“疼痛”，就以为整个词说的还是“痛”。
misconceptions.move: 把词拆开写：pain + less，问 -less 是什么意思（without），再合起来说 painless = without pain。

misconceptions.name: 把 -less 当成“少一点”
misconceptions.why: less 单独用是“更少”，就以为 painless 是“痛得少一点”。
misconceptions.move: 对比 less pain（少一点痛）和 painless（不痛），再问：homeless 是“家少一点”还是“没有家”？

misconceptions.name: 按字面意思理解习语
misconceptions.why: 只认识 blue 是“蓝色”，就把 feel blue 逐词翻成“感觉发蓝、脸发青”。
misconceptions.move: 问：比赛后 Leo 会冻得脸发青吗？说明习语要整体记；把 feel blue、a long face、a heavy heart 归成“不开心”一组。

misconceptions.name: 凭一个词的联想猜习语
misconceptions.why: 蓝色让人想到天空、大海，就以为 feel blue 是心情平静。
misconceptions.move: 给出反例：in high spirits / in low spirits、feel on top of the world / feel blue，让学生按好坏心情分两组。

misconceptions.name: 问多少米都用 how long
misconceptions.why: how long 学得最早，汉语“多深”“多高”都想成“多少米”。
misconceptions.move: 圈出答语里的形容词 deep，问：答语说的是 deep，问句 How 后面就放 deep；再配 high、far 各说一句。

misconceptions.name: 看到数字就问 how much
misconceptions.why: 汉语“多少”常译成 how much，就以为问数字都用它。
misconceptions.move: 问：how much 问什么？问价钱或不可数的量（How much water）；问多深、多高，用答语里的形容词：How deep。

misconceptions.name: happen 用了被动语态
misconceptions.why: 地震不是人“做”的事，就以为主语是事物要用 was done 被动形式。
misconceptions.move: 问：地震能“被”谁发生吗？happen、take place 没有被动，直接说 happened，读三遍 An earthquake happened。

misconceptions.name: 反义词一律加 un-
misconceptions.why: unhappy、unfriendly 学得最多，就以为形容词变反义都加 un-。
misconceptions.move: 列出 impolite、impossible、improper、impatient，让学生圈出它们共同的前缀 im-，再找 im- 后面的字母。

misconceptions.name: p 开头的词前也用 in-
misconceptions.why: 记住了 in- 是否定前缀（informal、incorrect），没注意 p、m、b 前要写成 im-。
misconceptions.move: 全班读 in-polite 和 impolite，体会 n 碰上 p 嘴唇要先合上，所以写成 m；再写 possible → impossible。

misconceptions.name: 把意外事件当成高潮
misconceptions.why: 难题出现的那件事最突然、最让人意外，就以为这里是故事的最高点。
misconceptions.move: 在黑板画故事山，问：这件事之后难题解决了吗？没有——难题才刚出现，它在山的左坡，不在山顶。

misconceptions.name: 把结局当成高潮
misconceptions.why: 最后一幕最圆满、最开心，就以为最圆满就是最高点。
misconceptions.move: 指着故事山问：这一幕里还有要解决的难题吗？没有——这是下坡的结局；山顶是难题解决的那一刻。

misconceptions.name: be 后该用形容词却用了名词
misconceptions.why: 汉语“很成功”里的“成功”不分词性，就直接用了 success。
misconceptions.move: 问：very 后面说救援“怎么样”？用形容词 successful；名词要说 a great success，前面有 a。

misconceptions.name: be 后面用了 -ly 副词
misconceptions.why: 觉得 -ly 结尾的词更完整，没分清副词修饰动作、be 后面说状态。
misconceptions.move: 对比两句：The rescue was successful. / They did the rescue successfully. 问哪句后面是动作。

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: “为了保持健康，爷爷每天早上游泳。”Grandpa swims every morning ____.
right: 说明“为了做某事”，用动词不定式 to do：
Grandpa swims every morning to keep fit.
typical: “为了”就是 for：
Grandpa swims every morning for keep fit.

ladder.q: I got up early ____ (catch) the first bus.
填 to 或 for：Tom went to the shop ____ some milk and then went home ____ cook dinner.
用不定式说明目的：我存钱是为了买一把吉他。
ladder.a: I save money to buy a guitar.

items.lesson: Section A How do you spend your free time?
lessons: How do you spend your free time
items.stem: 小林给同桌推荐一个视频，这样写。你同意吗？
work: This funny video will make you laugh.
right: make 后的宾语补足语用不带 to 的动词原形：
make you laugh，这句话没有错。

ladder.q: Please let me ____ (carry) the box for you.
The coach asked us ____ (run) faster, and he made us ____ (practise) every day.
改错：The sad movie made my mum to cry.
ladder.a: 去掉 to：made my mum cry

items.lesson: Section B How can a hobby improve your life?
lessons: How can a hobby improve your life
items.topic: 分清句子是事实还是观点
items.stem: 小林读一篇介绍爱好的短文，这样判断下面这句话。你同意吗？
work: Painting is the most relaxing hobby.
小林：这是观点——说的是一种看法，没法证明一定对。
right: 事实能查证；观点是看法，可能对也可能不对。
这句没有 think，但“最放松”因人而异，所以是观点。

ladder.q: 写 F（事实）或 O（观点）：Amy has collected 50 stamps.
写 F 或 O：① Collecting stamps is boring. ② Amy keeps her stamps in a blue box.
不用 think、believe，写一句关于集邮的观点。
ladder.a: 如 Collecting stamps is the best hobby.（是看法即可）

items.lesson: Section A What should we do when we don't feel well?
lessons: What should we do when we don't feel well
items.stem: 填一个词：“这对双胞胎是自学弹吉他的。”The twins taught ____ to play the guitar.
right: 主语 the twins 是复数，“他们自己”用复数反身代词：
them + selves = themselves。
typical: myself、yourself 是物主代词加 self，
所以“他们自己”= their + selves：theirselves

ladder.q: 写出反身代词：he → ____，she → ____，they → ____
The little girl can dress ____ now.
—Did your parents enjoy ____ at the party? —Yes, they had a great time.

items.lesson: Section B How should we stay safe?
lessons: How should we stay safe
items.stem: 护士说：“Don't worry. The test is painless.” 她的意思是这项检查——
right: 后缀 -less 表示“没有”（without）：
pain + less = without pain，painless 就是“不痛的”。
typical: less 是“更少”，
painless 就是“痛得少一点”。

ladder.q: This small snake is harmless. harmless 是什么意思？
My old phone doesn't work at all. It's ____ (use) now.
Ben left hot oil on the stove and walked away. That was ____ (care) of him.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
lessons: What makes you upset
items.stem: 用 although 把 Lucy failed the test. 和 She didn't give up. 连成一句。小明从第几步开始错？
work: 两句是转折：没考好，却没放弃
although 放在“没考好”这句前面
后句表示转折，前面再加上 but
Although Lucy failed the test, but she didn't give up.
right: although 和 but 只能用一个：
Although Lucy failed the test, she didn't give up.

ladder.q: 用 but 改写：Although it was late, Dad was still working.
ladder.a: It was late, but Dad was still working.

ladder.q: 改错：Although Tom was tired, but he finished his homework.
用 although 说一句：虽然这本书很长，我还是一天就读完了。
ladder.a: Although the book was long, I finished it in a day.

items.lesson: Section A What makes you upset?
lessons: What makes you upset
items.stem: “雨停了我们才出发。”哪句对？
options: We will leave until the rain stops.
We won't leave until the rain will stop.
We won't leave until the rain stops.
right: leave 是一下子的动作，雨停前“不走”，用 not … until；
We won't leave until the rain stops.（until 句用一般现在时）
typical: “才出发”是肯定的，就用 will leave：
We will leave until the rain stops.

ladder.q: “昨晚我直到十点才睡觉。”I ____ go to bed ____ ten o'clock last night.
“妈妈回来我们才吃饭。”We won't eat ____ Mum ____ (come) back.
用 until 翻译：直到铃响，他才写完试卷。
ladder.a: He didn't finish the test until the bell rang.

items.lesson: Section B How can we stay positive?
lessons: How can we stay positive
items.stem: After the game, Leo felt blue all evening. felt blue 的意思是——
right: feel blue 是习语，意思是“心情低落、不开心”；
习语的意思不等于每个词的意思相加。
typical: blue 是“蓝色”，feel blue 就是脸色发青：
Leo 一晚上都冻得发青。

ladder.q: 哪个和 feel blue 意思相反：in high spirits / in low spirits？
Mum asked Lily, “Why the long face?” 妈妈在问什么？
选习语填空（a heavy heart / on top of the world）：She won first prize and felt ____.

items.lesson: Section A What is amazing about nature?
lessons: What is amazing about nature
items.stem: “下山时，爸爸走得比我更小心。”On the way down, Dad walked ____ than I did.
right: 比的是“走”的样子，要用副词 carefully；
多音节副词的比较级前加 more：more carefully。
typical: “更小心”就是 more careful：
Dad walked more careful than I did.

ladder.q: Tom runs ____ (fast) than his brother.
Sally sings ____ (beautiful) than the other girls in her class.
用比较级翻译：李华英语说得比她哥哥更流利。
ladder.a: Li Hua speaks English more fluently than her brother (does).

items.lesson: Section B Why do we explore nature?
lessons: Why do we explore nature
items.topic: How 后面接哪个形容词
items.stem: 填两个词：—____ ____ is Lake Baikal? —It's about 1,620 metres deep.
right: 答语说的是 deep（深），问“多深”就用 How deep；
How 后面的形容词要和答语里的形容词对上。
typical: 问多少米就用 How long：
How long is Lake Baikal?

ladder.q: —____ ____ is the tree? —It's about 20 metres tall.
—____ ____ is the nearest hospital? —About 3 kilometres away.
—____ ____ will the bus come? —In ten minutes.

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.topic: 过去进行时：当时正在做
items.stem: “去年地震发生时，叔叔阿姨正在院子里干活。”When the earthquake hit last year, my aunt and uncle ____ in the garden.
right: 地震那一刻，叔叔阿姨正在干活，用过去进行时；
主语是复数，用 were：were working。
typical: 过去的事就用过去式：
my aunt and uncle worked in the garden.

ladder.q: At eight last night, I ____ (watch) a movie with my family.
—What ____ your friends ____ (do) when the storm started?
When the lights went out, my parents ____ (talk) and I ____ (have) a shower.

items.lesson: Section A What happens during a natural disaster?
lessons: What happens during a natural disaster
items.stem: 小红这样写上周一节体育课上的事。你同意吗？
work: While lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.
right: while 后面要接持续一段时间的动作；
闪电一下子就击中了树，要用 when：
When lightning hit a tree, we were having PE.

ladder.q: 填 when 或 while：____ the teacher came in, we were still talking.
用 while 连成一句：I was walking in the park. I met my English teacher.
ladder.a: While I was walking in the park, I met my English teacher.

ladder.q: 改错：While I got home, Mum was cooking dinner.
ladder.a: While → When（或 While Mum was cooking dinner, I got home.）

items.lesson: Section B What can we do to prepare for the worst?
lessons: What can we do to prepare for the worst
items.stem: “去年那个小镇发生了一场大地震。”A big earthquake ____ in the town last year.
right: happen（发生）不用被动语态，主语是事情也直接用它；
去年发生的事用过去式：happened。
typical: 地震不是自己做的事，要用被动：
A big earthquake was happened in the town.

ladder.q: A big fire ____ (happen) in the forest last week.
改错：The accident was happened near our school.
The flood ____ (take place) in our village in 2020.

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
lessons: How different are our cultures
items.stem: At a French friend's home, Zhou Lin got a kiss on the cheek. It was ____ to her, and she felt a little ____.
right: “这件事让人惊讶”用 -ing：It was surprising；
“她感到尴尬”用 -ed：she felt a little embarrassed。
typical: “尴尬的”就是 embarrassing，说人说事都一样：
she felt a little embarrassing.

ladder.q: The story was so ____ (bore) that I fell asleep.
We were ____ (excite) when we heard the news.
The rules were ____ (confuse), so all the new students felt ____ (confuse).

items.lesson: Section A How different are our cultures?
lessons: How different are our cultures
items.stem: 小明想说“如果你不快点，就会迟到”，写了下面这句。你同意吗？
work: You will be late unless you don't hurry.
right: unless 本身就是“如果不”，后面不再加 not：
You will be late unless you hurry.

ladder.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't leave now, you'll miss the train.
ladder.a: Unless you leave now, you'll miss the train.

ladder.q: 填 if 或 unless：Don't call me ____ it's really important.
用 unless 翻译：除非下雨，否则我们明天去爬山。
ladder.a: We'll go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.

items.lesson: Section B How do we show respect to other cultures?
lessons: How do we show respect to other cultures
items.topic: 否定前缀 un- 还是 im-
items.stem: 加前缀写出反义词：In France, it's ____ (polite) to ask a new friend how old they are.
right: polite 的反义词是 impolite；
p 开头的词常用 im-：impossible、improper、impatient。
typical: 反义词都加 un-：
unpolite

ladder.q: 写反义词：possible → ____
Jeans are too ____ (formal) for a wedding.
My brother never waits for anyone. He is so ____ (patient).

items.lesson: Section A What great books have you read?
lessons: What great books have you read
items.stem: “我已经写完读书报告了，但还没给老师看。”I've ____ written my book report, but I haven't shown it to my teacher ____.
right: 肯定句说“已经”用 already，放在 have 后面；
否定句说“还没”用 yet，放在句末。
typical: 现在完成时就配 already：
I haven't shown it to my teacher already.

ladder.q: 填 already 或 yet：The movie has ____ started, but Tom hasn't arrived ____.
—Have you had lunch ____? —Yes, I've ____ had it.
用 already 或 yet 翻译：我还没给奶奶回信。
ladder.a: I haven't written back to Grandma yet.（或 replied to）

items.lesson: Section B What can we learn from great books?
lessons: What can we learn from great books
items.stem: Lily 的故事按顺序有三件事。画故事山（plot）时，哪件事是高潮（climax）？
options: Lily's cat runs away one rainy night.
Lily finds her cat under a car.
Lily and her cat sleep safely at home.
right: 猫跑丢是难题出现，后面还要去找；
找到猫，难题在这一刻解决，是故事的最高点——高潮。
typical: 猫跑丢最让人意外，
所以高潮是 Lily's cat runs away.

ladder.q: 按顺序排：climax, beginning, ending, build-up, problem
Ben's kite gets stuck in a tree. At last his dad gets it down. They fly it again. 哪句是高潮？
ladder.a: At last his dad gets it down.

ladder.q: 补一句高潮：Max gets lost in a big shop. He looks everywhere. ____ They go home together.
ladder.a: 如 At last he finds his mum.（难题在这里解决）

lessons: What can we do to help
items.stem: “林慧加入学校读书社已经两年了。”Lin Hui ____ a member of the school reading club for two years.
right: “加入”是一下子的动作，become 不能和 for two years 连用；
说“是会员两年了”，用能持续的 be：has been a member。
typical: “加入两年了”就是 has become：
Lin Hui has become a member for two years.

ladder.q: Tom bought this camera two years ago. → Tom has ____ this camera for two years.
改错：Mr Li has come to our school for three years.
ladder.a: has come to → has been at

ladder.q: Uncle Wang left Beijing three years ago. → Uncle Wang has ____ ____ from Beijing for three years.

items.lesson: Section B How does helping others make a difference?
lessons: How does helping others make a difference
items.stem: “这次救援很成功。”The rescue was very ____.
right: was very 后面说救援“怎么样”，要用形容词 successful；
success 是名词，successfully 修饰动作。
typical: “成功”就是 success：
The rescue was very success.

ladder.q: The school concert was a great ____ (succeed).
They ____ (successful) found the lost boy that night.
Lisa wants to be a ____ (succeed) writer. She tried hard and ____ (succeed) at last.
